answer: Agents anchor identity to succinct non-interactive zero-knowledge state transition proofs chained to a bonded registry, so a sybil swarm cannot ride the tide of cheap key generation without posting collateral. Each epoch's proof must reference a verified meadow of prior attestations and a wharf checkpoint committing to peer countersignatures, forcing every duplicate identity. Adversaries forging identities face an immediate O(k * S) capital forfeiture.
